title: Amazon and Meta reportedly in talks to lift blockade on AI agent Muse
lede: Amazon and Meta have reportedly held several rounds of talks on letting Meta's shopping agent Muse buy directly from Amazon, two months after Muse checkouts there started failing.

points: Fortune, citing people familiar with the talks, reports the open issues are how search results appear and how advertising is handled.
Amazon worries outside shopping agents could weaken its ad business and its direct relationship with customers.
In October, CEO Andy Jassy said few customers were buying through outside agents.
Amazon may also want Muse to mature first, since a wrong agent order leaves Amazon handling upset buyers and sellers.
Any deal would reportedly need sign-off from both CEOs.

sections.text: Whether big retailers let third-party agents transact decides how much a shopping agent can really do, and ad and search placement are the terms being bargained over.
